title: Full photo
description: The user's photo or clip fills the whole slide and settles slowly from a gentle zoom; a soft shade on the free side carries a large title and one line. With a face box the words go to the side away from the face.

props.src: required, a photo or an mp4 of the user's own
props.title: a large line on the picture, 1-8 words
props.side: left, right or bottom: where the words go (default: away from the face, else left)
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person

example.alt: A croissant on a wooden table in soft morning light
example.title: Baked before we open
